investigations.summary: PMM-T2036 failed again in all 11 nightly lanes (docker, docker arm64, ami, helm, ha, compat 3.7.1/3.8.0/3.8.1/3.9.0/3.9.1, gssapi). Every time it was the only hard failure, and every time with 'Metrics without data are: Failing Backup Agents' (Nightly 2/4 shard). The PMM-T1698, PMM-T2401 and PMM-T318 failures on helm, ha, ami, docker and compat 3.9.0 passed on retry. Same cause as nights 103 and 104: the Failing Backup Agents table that percona/pmm#6109 added is empty when no PBM agent fails, and MongodbBackupDetails.noDataMetrics on main still doesn't list it. The fix (noDataMetrics = ['Failing Backup Agents']) is in pmm-qa#1740, which is still open and unmerged. Merging it clears these lanes. Deduped from the run logs, not re-reproduced.

Nightly Test Suite run 43127073829, E2E Inventory|Image renderer (amd64 and arm64): PMM-T1946 'verify image renderer usage' (@image-renderer) failed all 3 attempts with 'Missing dashboard panels: Failed advisors'. The other 18 tests passed. percona/pmm#5656 (PMM-14109 Improve Advisor UX, merged 2026-11-11 21:47 UTC) removed the Failed advisors / Advisor Insights panels from the Home dashboard on purpose, and 3-dev-latest now ships that. home.ts metrics() and imageRenderer.test.ts on main still expect the panel. pmm-qa#1712 (draft, PMM-14109 tests) already rewrites PMM-T1946 to render a text panel on a dashboard the test creates. It was waiting on #5656, which has now merged, so #1712 can come out of draft. PMM-T1946 stays red until it lands. Deduped from the run logs and the #5656 diff, not re-reproduced.
